title: EtaleSetLocalStageImageEquations
statement: Let I be any category, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram, c any cone with apex X and projections p_j, i₀ an object, G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀) [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], W an étale object of D(i₀), and t ∈ (p_i₀^*G)(p_i₀^*W). For j in Over(op i₀) set f_j = D(j.hom), H_j = f_j^*G, L = p_i₀^*G, Y_j = f_j^*W, B_j = base change along p_j, e_j : p_i₀^*W ≅ B_j(Y_j) the iterated-base-change isomorphism, and β_j = β(p_j,f_j,p_i₀) [def-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-comparison]. Given a finite family a_q : V_q → Y_j and sections s_q ∈ H_j(V_q) with β_j(s_q) = L(B_j(a_q) ≫ e_j.inv)(t), for every r : j′ → j put b = base change along D(r.left), d : Y_j′ ≅ b(Y_j), V′_q = b(V_q), a′_q = b(a_q) ≫ d.inv and s′_q = β(D(r.left),f_j,f_j′)(s_q). Then β_j′(s′_q) = L(B_j′(a′_q) ≫ e_j′.inv)(t) for every q. No limit, directedness, affineness, covering, or compatibility assumption is needed.

proof.text: Expand the comparisons as adjunction units followed by unit-compatible composition isomorphisms. Unit naturality in the sheaf and associativity of the chosen inverse-image comparisons identify the composite comparison with β_j followed by restriction along the base-change pasting isomorphism.

Substitute the equations with t. Combine restrictions by the functor composition law. Naturality and associativity of pullback pasting identify the resulting arrow with B_j′(a′_q) ≫ e_j′.inv: the maps have identical projections to W, V_q and the cone apex. Equality elimination restores the commuting triangle witnesses.

    {I : Type u} [Category I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (c : Cone D) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W))) :
    let H := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G
    let L := (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let Y := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).obj W
    let e := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app W
    let β := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      etaleSetSheafComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
        (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G
    ∀ (j : Over (op i₀)) (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶ Y j) (s : ∀ q, (H j).obj.obj (op (V q))),
      (∀ q, (β j).hom.app (op (V q)) (s q) =
        L.obj.map ((B j).map (a q) ≫ (e j).inv).op t) →
    ∀ (j' : Over (op i₀)) (r : j' ⟶ j),
      let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map r.left)
      let hr := (D.map_comp r.left j.hom).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun z : j'.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map z) r.w)
      let d := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (D.map r.left) (D.map j.hom) (D.map j'.hom) hr.symm).app W
      let V' := fun q ↦ b.obj (V q)
      let a' := fun q ↦ b.map (a q) ≫ d.inv
      let s' := fun q ↦ (etaleSetSheafComparison (D.map r.left) (D.map j.hom)
        (D.map j'.hom) hr G).hom.app (op (V q)) (s q)
      ∀ q, (β j').hom.app (op (V' q)) (s' q) =
        L.obj.map ((B j').map (a' q) ≫ (e j').inv).op t
